description: This file contains helper functions for filling measurement and request data structures related to NRPPa ASN.1 messages, including measurement initiation, OTDOA info, measurement results, and positioning requests, within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

methods.name: fill_nrppa_e_cid_meas_initiation_request
methods.description: Fills a nrppa_e_cid_meas_initiation_request structure from ASN.1 input.

methods.name: fill_nrppa_otdoa_information_request
methods.description: Fills a nrppa_otdoa_information_request structure from ASN.1 input.

methods.name: fill_meas_result_ss_rsrp_item
methods.description: Creates an RSRP measurement result item for SS BSRP from cell measurement data.

methods.name: fill_meas_result_csi_rsrp_item
methods.description: Creates an RSRP measurement result item for CSI RSRP from cell measurement data.

methods.name: fill_meas_result_ss_rsrq_item
methods.description: Creates an RSRQ measurement result item for SS BSRQ from cell measurement data.

methods.name: fill_meas_result_csi_rsrq_item
methods.description: Creates an RSRQ measurement result item for CSI RSRQ from cell measurement data.

methods.name: fill_meas_results
methods.description: Generates measurement results (RSRP/RSRQ) based on measurement quantity and cell data.

methods.name: fill_e_cid_measurement_result
methods.description: Fills an e_cid measurement result structure from cell measurement data, including requested measurement types.

methods.name: fill_trp_information_request
methods.description: Fills a trp_information_request_t structure from ASN.1 input.

methods.name: fill_positioning_information_request
methods.description: Fills a positioning_information_request_t structure from ASN.1 input.

methods.name: fill_positioning_activation_request
methods.description: Fills a positioning_activation_request_t structure from ASN.1 input.

methods.name: fill_measurement_request
methods.description: Fills a measurement_request_t structure from ASN.1 input.
